summary: Provides a general mechanism for using the header extension feature of RTP, the Real-Time Transport Protocol. It allows a small number of small extensions in each packet, from a large universe of possible extensions with decentralized registration. The extensions in use are signaled when the session is set up. It was replaced by RFC 8285.

eli5.summary: Each package in a video call can carry a small sticker with extra info, like volume level. This describes a tidy way to add several stickers. It was replaced by RFC 8285.

questions: how to add extension to rtp packets
